Review about 92.5 silver jewellery only.

The store sells 92.5 silver jewelleries, be it earrings, rings or any other thing at exorbitant rates.

There's no explanation behind the price other than, "it's imported and prices are fixed."

They don't bargain either, giving the same reason.

As if the other rich, named big jewellers in the same area or in the whole of India are a big sick joke to you.

They don't know anything about market or maybe they think they can fool the customers.

Shame on them.

They should close the shop.

I bought the same design at another big brand jewellery shop for 400 which this shop charged for 900.

So pathetic.
